findings.message: Password reset tokens are now generated with `random.choices`, which uses the non-cryptographic Mersenne Twister PRNG; its output can be predicted after observing enough values, letting an attacker forge reset tokens and take over accounts. The previous `secrets.token_urlsafe` was already URL-safe.
This changes how reset tokens are generated but adds no test, while the contributing guide requires a test with every change in behaviour.
